# Descriptions
@@ 2
When faced with a choice about which he has little or no information (e.g.,
which corridor leads outside the quickest), the caster may cast this spell and
the GM will determine which way he goes, biasing the choice favorably by 25%
(e.g., roll d100: correct on a 26-100, incorrect on a 1-25).
@@ 4
Caster gains a vision of what will probably happen in the next minute if he
takes a specific action.
@@ 5
Caster has a dream relating to a topic decided upon just before retiring. The
caster must sleep for a normal sleep cycle (minimum of 4 hours) for this spell
to work.
@@ 6
Allows the caster to enchant general type magic items giving them a Class I
bonus.
@@ 7
As Intuitions I, except caster gets to gaze 3 minutes into the future.
@@ 8
Caster gets a vision of the events surrounding the death of any 1 dead target
through the eyes of the deceased. He also gets a view of the killer (if any).
The caster must be within 10' of the corpse. The corpse must have died within
a number of years equal to the caster’s level.
@@ 9
Caster can make contact with any 1 known target he is acquainted with. This
spell will enable the caster to learn the specific location (direction and
distance only) of the other being.
@@ 10
As General I, except general type magic items with bonuses can be enchanted
with a Class II bonus.
@@ 11
Caster receives (usually from his patron deity) a “yes” or a “no” answer to a
question on a single topic. This spell may be used a maximum of once per day.
@@ 13
As Intuitions I, except caster gets to gaze 10 minutes into the future.
@@ 15
As General I, except general type magic items with bonuses can be enchanted
with a +15 bonus to a skill or ability. A spell adders and multipliers are
treated differently; the alchemist may enchant a +3 spell adder or a x2
multiplier.
@@ 16
The target of this spell is a small pool of clear, clean water. The water must
be calm (and remain calm for the spell duration). The caster may designate a
topic and a vision will appear in the pool that relates to the topic. This
vision normally takes 5-50 rounds.
@@ 18
As Channel Opening I, except for range.
@@ 20
As Commune I, except caster can receive a more detailed answer (e.g., a name
or a short phrase) to a question involving only 1 concept.
@@ 25
As Magic Basin I, except up to two topics may be designated (5-50 rounds is
required for each one).
@@ 35
As General I, except general type magic items with bonuses can be enchanted
with a Class IV bonus.
@@ 50
Caster receives detailed information from his deity on a single topic
question.
